name: Galleria Overlook

floors.name: Level 1 — Ground: the Stem, Gardens & Arena

interactables.name: Root Stair
pages: The mushroom's roots spiral down into the stem. Down to Level 1.

interactables.name: Root Stair (up)
pages: Up the root stair to Skeeton's, under the cap.

interactables.name: Root Stair (down)
pages: Down the root stair into the rock. Sub-level 1: shops.

interactables.name: Root Stair (up)
pages: Up the root stair to Level 1 and the arena.

interactables.name: Root Stair (down)
pages: Down the root stair. You can smell the food court already.

interactables.name: Root Stair (up)
pages: Up the root stair to the S1 shops.

interactables.name: Cliff Stairs
pages: A long switchback stair bolted to the cliff. The sea is VERY far down.
Down you go, to the Dining Balcony.

interactables.name: Cliff Stairs
pages: The cliff stairs climb to the Absulinaught Arena. Your calves file a complaint.

interactables.name: The Chute of Attunement
pages: A polished slide corkscrews down through the floor. A plaque: CHUTE OF ATTUNEMENT. Keep arms, legs and blades inside the chute.
WHEEEEEEEE—
—you shoot out into the food court. Attuned? Launched? Hard to tell. Both?

interactables.name: Point and Chute Stair
pages: The store's inner staircase, back up to the 107 showroom on Level 1.

interactables.name: Mopsy Grindlewick (janitor)
pages: Mopsy leans on her mop. 'Psst. You look like a brawler. Twenty-two years I've cleaned this place. Wanna hear something weird?'
'Three times this week, Goolax folks asked me to mop a room that ain't on any directory. Under the arena, they said. Then they said FORGET IT.'
'Skeeton's put up a fresh store directory by their root stair. Somebody misprinted it... or DIDN'T. Heh. Go read it close.'
'Don't tell Gantry I told you. He'd only put it on his list of nice things, and it ain't nice, love. It's WEIRD.'
brushoffs: 'Still here, love? Mind the wet bit. It's the only wet bit and I made it special.'
'You're standing on my clean. I can see your boots in it.'
'GUARDS! ...Gantry, love, move this one along. Gently.'

interactables.name: Skeeton's Store Directory
pages: SKEETON'S — ALL OF LEVEL 2. Apparel (N). Sea & Sport (E). Home & Hearth (S). Beauty & Gifts (W).
...wait. Down at the bottom, in tiny print: 'UNIT B-HALF — GOOLAX GUEST SERVICES. Beneath the south stands.'
Someone has scribbled next to it: 'Lost? Ask the moss by the goblin statue. The planter knows.'
lockedPages: SKEETON'S — ALL OF LEVEL 2. Apparel (N). Sea & Sport (E). Home & Hearth (S). Beauty & Gifts (W). Fitting rooms: north. Refunds: never.

interactables.name: Bromeliad Planter
pages: You dig in the moss beside the goblin statue... clink! A brass key tag on a fizzy-green ribbon.
Stamped on it: 'GOOLAX STAFF — PLAY JINGLE 7 TO VERIFY.' What kind of security is THAT?
Somewhere down in the food court, an intercom automaton takes jingle requests.
lockedPages: A planter of bromeliads next to the goblin statue. Something buzzes in the moss. A bee. Just a bee.

interactables.name: Jingle Request Slot
pages: You slide the brass tag into the slot. The automaton freezes. 'STAFF TAG ACCEPTED. NOW PLAYING: GOOLAX STAFF JINGLE SEVEN.'
♪ Four big bubbles, ONE small pop! Two for the brawl, and NINE on top! Goolax! Fizz the fight! ♪
The automaton spits the tag back out and beeps. 'VERIFICATION COMPLETE. PLEASE FORGET THAT.' Four... one... two... nine.
lockedPages: A brass slot labelled JINGLE REQUESTS — STAFF TAGS ONLY. It is shaped exactly like a little key tag.

interactables.name: Pippa Fizzwhistle (Goolax intern)
pages: Pippa gasps. 'You're humming Staff Jingle Seven! You must be one of the brawlers they want to meet! I've never actually met one of you up close!'
'The back office is under the arena's SOUTH stands. Look for the banner with the big fizzing G. Push the G. Firmly. It's shy. I pushed it too gently on my first day.'

'Then the keypad wants the jingle. Oh, and they'll give you a laminated VIP card! It doesn't do anything. The visiting vendors set up right here after each contest, open to every competitor. I laid the mats out myself!'
lockedPages: Pippa is taping GOOLAX stickers onto six empty booth mats. 'Visiting vendors set up here after every contest! Very exclusive!'
'Exclusive how? Um. Ask a grown-up Goolax person. I'm an intern. I mostly carry tape.'

interactables.name: Goolax MALL BRAWL Banner
pages: You push the big fizzing G. Click. The whole banner swings inward like a door. Cool air and the smell of foam fingers.
A service corridor runs under the stands.
lockedPages: A huge banner: GOOLAX PRESENTS MALL BRAWL 2026 — FIZZ THE FIGHT! The G is drawn as a fizzing bubble. It looks... pushable?
You give it a poke. Nothing. Maybe you need to know what you're doing first.

hidden.hint: One Goolax banner sways, though there's no breeze.

interactables.name: Keypad Door
pages: A keypad: GOOLAX STAFF ONLY. You tap 4... 1... 2... 9.
Pfssssht! The door hisses open like a freshly cracked Goolax.
lockedPages: A keypad: GOOLAX STAFF ONLY. Four digits. You try 1-2-3-4. It plays a sad little trombone.

hidden.hint: A keypad glows beside a seam in the wall.

interactables.name: Way Back Out
pages: A crack of daylight behind the banner. You slip back out to the arena concourse.

interactables.name: Dropped Lanyard
pages: A Goolax lanyard: 'HELLO MY NAME IS: Temp #44.' On the back, in pen: 'jingle 7 = door code. DON'T WRITE THIS DOWN.'

interactables.name: Crates of Foam Fingers
pages: Crates stamped FOAM FINGERS — GOOLAX PINK, GOOLAX GREEN, GOOLAX 'REGRETTABLE ORANGE (DISCONTINUED)'.

interactables.name: Box of Spare Whistles
pages: A box of referee whistles. One is labelled 'THE LOUD ONE. DO NOT.' You do not.

interactables.name: Fennimore Bubblesworth (Goolax liaison)
pages: A halfling in a fizzy-green blazer leaps up. 'A competitor! You found us! Nobody finds us. We have SO many snacks.'
'Fennimore Bubblesworth, Goolax Competitor Liaison. Congratulations on your initiative, your curiosity, and your total disregard for signage.'
He stamps a shiny card: GOOLAX VIP. 'Doesn't do anything, technically. The booths in S106 sell to every competitor anyway. But it's laminated.'
'Tell your teammates — if they can find the place. Rules are rules! Now. Fizz?'

interactables.name: Competitor Rankings Whiteboard
pages: A whiteboard: COMPETITOR RANKINGS — MALL BRAWL 2026. It is completely blank.
In the corner, small: 'do NOT fill in until after the buzzer. Again. Looking at you, Gerald.'

interactables.name: Filing Cabinet: A–M
pages: Folders: 'Arena Insurance (Dragons)', 'Foam Finger Incident', 'Healing Potion Flavours (Banañon? Y/N)'.
A folder labelled 'MASCOT AUDITIONS' just contains a drawing of a very sad bubble.

interactables.name: Filing Cabinet: N–Z
pages: Folders: 'Pop-Up Vendors', 'Referee Revival Waivers', 'Yelling (Approved Volumes)'.
One drawer is just Goolax bottle caps. Hundreds. Someone is collecting for a prize.

interactables.name: Goolax Fizz Fridge
pages: A humming fridge of Goolax in every flavour. A sticky note: 'Competitors drink free in here. Shh.'
You crack one. It fizzes so hard your ears pop.

interactables.name: Liaison Desk
pages: Stacks of laminated VIP cards, a stamp shaped like a bubble, and a mug: WORLD'S OKAYEST LIAISON.

interactables.name: Prize Wheel Prototype
pages: A cardboard prize wheel. The wedges read: GOLD, GOLD, GLORY, FIZZ, GOLD, 'A HUG FROM FENNIMORE'. It has been spun a lot.

interactables.name: Suspicious Plant
pages: A plastic plant with a tag: 'REAL PLANT (HOMOLOGATED)'. It is not real. It is homologated.

interactables.name: Welcome Mat
pages: The mat says: WIPE YOUR FEET, CHAMP.

interactables.name: Office Intercom
pages: A tiny speaker on a fern. It's playing Goolax Staff Jingle Seven on loop. The liaison hums along every single time.

interactables.name: Tilda Bramblecap (Info Kiosk)
pages: 'Welcome to the Galleria Overlook, Banañon Town's premier shopping experience! The arena's east, the gardens south, and the food court is DOWN.'
'Lost? Everyone's lost. The mall is a mushroom, and mushrooms aren't laid out for people. I drew my own map my first year. Nineteen years on, it's still right.'
'Skeeton's is upstairs under the cap. Shops in the rock below. And the Dining Balcony hangs off the cliff, so maybe hold on to your hat.'
'Every lost child ends up here. I keep a tin of barley sugars and a list of names. One boy's on it eleven times. He says he wasn't lost, he was scouting.'

0: 'Welcome, welcome! Tryouts are on the ninth of Rest in the Absulinaught Arena. Our very own mall team gets picked!'
'Arena east, gardens south, food court down. Mind the cliff.'
1: 'Tryouts are done! The arena crew is STILL sweeping up. Next contest is away, at Immia Beach Mega Mall in Lorfida.'
'Arena east, gardens south, food court down. Mind the drag queens. I hear they bite. Stylishly.'
2: 'Back from Lorfida! Next up, the Sloopermarket in Sloppy Bottom Bay. Pack a towel, it's a wet one. I've been told the directions there are just: follow the gulls.'
3: 'Next contest is in Panto! Theatre people. Expect monologues. Arena east, gardens south, food court down.'
4: 'Off to Moffidge next! And the Selunemas decorations are up, so if you see a D'fain, please don't fight him. He's a volunteer.'
5: 'The final contest is on Selunemas! Where? Goolax won't say. Even I don't know, and I know where EVERYTHING is. Nineteen years, and I've never had to say that.'
6: 'Happy Selunemas! What a season. The arena crew has asked for a very long nap. I've put a cot behind the kiosk, and it's mine.'

brushoffs: 'Still lost? It's down. The answer is usually down.'
'I have other visitors, love. Some of them are actually lost.'
'SECURITY! ...No, it's fine, Gantry, back to your clipboard. But do shoo.'

interactables.name: Mall Directory
pages: GALLERIA OVERLOOK — DIRECTORY. L2: Skeeton's. L1: the Stem shops, Absulinaught Arena, Rainforest Gardens. S1: Shops in the rock. S2: Food Court & Dining Balcony.
NEW! The Leyline Operator, just inside the main doors on the right. One-rider trips to Cogskill Arcade, Gok'Gok Harbor.
A red star: YOU ARE HERE. Someone has added a second star labelled 'YOU WERE HERE' and a third, 'YOU WILL BE HERE (FOOD COURT)'.

interactables.name: Founder's Statue
pages: A bronze dwarf hoists a banañon to the sky. Plaque: 'GRUMBALD IRONPEEL — FIRST TO SELL A BANAÑON ON THIS ROCK. PROBABLY.'
Someone has put a tiny paper Goolax hat on him.

4: Grumbald Ironpeel has a fluffy D'fain beard tied over his bronze one. The banañon has a bow on it.
5: Grumbald Ironpeel has a fluffy D'fain beard tied over his bronze one. Somebody added tinsel. And a second banañon.

interactables.name: Goolax Banner
pages: GOOLAX PRESENTS: MALL BRAWL 2026! Brawn! Brilliance! Fizz!

0: GOOLAX PRESENTS: MALL BRAWL 2026! TRYOUTS 9 REST, ABSULINAUGHT ARENA. 'Do you have what it takes? (A pulse. Mostly a pulse.)'
1: GOOLAX MALL BRAWL: NEXT STOP, IMMIA BEACH MEGA MALL, LORFIDA! Cheer on your Galleria team!
2: GOOLAX MALL BRAWL: NEXT STOP, THE SLOOPERMARKET, SLOPPY BOTTOM BAY! (Bring a towel.)
3: GOOLAX MALL BRAWL: NEXT STOP, PANTO! The show must go on!
4: GOOLAX MALL BRAWL: NEXT STOP, MOFFIDGE! The banner has a strip of Selunemas tinsel taped along the top.
5: GOOLAX MALL BRAWL — THE FINAL CONTEST, SELUNEMAS DAY! Venue: '???' The question marks are glittered.
6: GOOLAX THANKS YOU FOR A FIZZTASTIC SEASON! See you next year!

interactables.name: Trash Can
pages: A trash can shaped like a mushroom. It burps politely when you lift the lid.
Inside: a Goolax bottle, half a banañon, and a crumpled tryout form that just says 'NO' in big letters.

interactables.name: Bartholomew Quill (tourist)
pages: 'I came all the way from Quone to see a mall shaped like a mushroom. Eleven years in the Records Hall, filing other people's holidays, and it's SO shaped like a mushroom.'
'Is it true the balcony hangs right off the cliff, over the strait? I'll take your word for it. I'll take a drawing of it, actually. Someone else's.'
'Every ship in the world sails past this rock and I spent the morning choosing between two pairs of socks. I bought both. On holiday you're allowed.'
'Back home they call it the Squat Squabble, or the Rebellion, or the Restoration, depending who's buying. I call it the unpleasantness and leave before anyone buys.'

4: 'I bought a D'fain hat! Does it make me look jolly? Be honest. No, wait, be kind. I've decided to spend the rest of my holiday feeling jolly and I need help.'
'Every ship in the strait has Selunemas lanterns up. I counted sixty from the balcony before my hands went numb. At home they're rationing lamp-oil. I stayed out a while longer.'

brushoffs: 'Oh, hello again! I've drawn the mushroom three more times since. It keeps coming out as a lamp.'
'I'd love to chat, but the light's changing on the cap, and it only does this for about four minutes.'
'I'm on holiday. You're lovely, but you are not my holiday. Off you go, please.'

interactables.name: Nib Tumbletoe (age 7)
pages: 'When I grow up I'm gonna be IN the mall brawl. I'm gonna punch a mall. Not this one. This one's nice. A different mall.'
'My balloon is a Goolax balloon. It fizzes. Not really. I just say it does, and then I go fsssss, and then it does.'
'Did you know there's a cat that lives in the mall? I saw her! She saw me. We're friends now. She doesn't know yet, but we are.'
'My brother Tobble has a whistle and he blows it at me. When I'm ten I'm getting a whistle and I'm gonna blow it at HIM. For a whole year.'
brushoffs: 'You again! Want to see my tooth? It's still wobbly. Look. LOOK.'
'I'm busy. I'm being a brawler. Brawlers don't talk, they do THIS.' He punches the air near your knee.
'MUM! A stranger keeps talking to me! ...She's at the soap shop. But BYE.'

interactables.name: Duchess Marmalade (the mall cat)
pages: An enormous orange cat flops at your feet. Her name tag: DUCHESS MARMALADE — MALL CAT — DO NOT FEED (SHE LIES).
She lets you pet her exactly three times, then stalks off toward the root stair. Upstairs, maybe?

hidden.hint: Something big and orange flicks its tail by the bench.

interactables.name: Wendell Froth (Suds & Duds & Beyond)
pages: 'Welcome to Suds & Duds & Beyond! My mum ran a laundry in Beggle for thirty years. I just cut out the middle step: you buy the soap AND the trousers.'
'Every sock is washed in our own soap before it's folded. The boss calls that synergy. I call it the only way we could afford to stock both.'
'The soap shop on the north wall told a customer we're "a laundry with ambitions". I've had it printed on our carrier bags.'
'Buy a bar, get a bib. Buy a robe, get a rope. Buy the rope, get a bar. I've been trying to find the way out of this offer since Learn.'

pages.text: 'Oh. It's YOU. The boss says hi. She didn't, but she was thinking it so loudly I could hear it from the stockroom.'
'New line this week: Fresh Start soap. The boss named it herself, then stood very still for a while, looking across at your shop.'
'Seven pastels this season. If you ever want to try the Dawn Peach, the fitting room's at the back, and I will never tell a soul you were here.'
'The boss's sweetheart picked our newest scent. It's called Moving On. I've been told to put it in the window facing your shop, and I have, and I feel terrible.'
'Discount for the boss's old best friend? Let me check the ledger. ...She's written a number here, crossed it out, and written it again, smaller.'

4: 'Selunemas special: D'fain soap and a D'fain onesie, sold together. My nephew wore the onesie into the bath with the soap. Cleanest he's been since Heal.'
'Suds & Duds & Beyond: the only store where you can buy a gift, the gift wrap, and the soap for when your aunt drops the gift in the gravy.'
5: 'Selunemas special: D'fain soap and a D'fain onesie, sold together. My nephew wore the onesie into the bath with the soap. Cleanest he's been since Heal.'

brushoffs: 'Still here? I've told you about the socks. I told you with feeling.'
'I can fold trousers or I can fold conversation, and only one of those pays the rent.'
'I'm going to start charging for visits. A copper a minute. You owe me nine.'

stock.name: Bar of Soap (with sock)
stock.desc: Soap & a sock & a story: the boss said 'add value', so every bar gets a sock. The sock is clean. I washed it myself, in the soap.

stock.name: Common Clothes
stock.desc: Pre-washed, pre-folded, pre-loved by nobody. My mum's laundry rule in Beggle: wash it twice before a stranger wears it once.

stock.name: Traveler's Clothes
stock.desc: Sturdy, pocketed & faintly lavender. Mum swore lavender kept the moths off. It doesn't, but they leave looking calmer.

stock.name: Fine Clothes
stock.desc: For a night out, a night in & the morning after. Pressed on Mum's old mangle, which I carried up the cliff road on my back.

stock.name: Costume Clothes
stock.desc: Arena dress-up: capes, crowns & a whole rail of D'fain. Beards sold separately, because the beards are where the margin lives.

stock.name: Lavender Pyjamas
stock.desc: Sleep IN the smell. A customer in Beggle wrote to say she hasn't had a bad dream since. She also hasn't washed them.

stock.name: Arena Stain Remover
stock.desc: Gets out sand, sweat & soup, in rising order of difficulty. Tested on a brawler's tabard that had all three and a fourth thing.

stock.name: Bath Bomb, Smoke
stock.desc: Throw it: a 10-foot cloud of smoke, heavily obscured, until the end of your next turn. Five gold dearer than across the Stem: the 'concept surcharge'.

interactables.name: Soap-and-Trousers Display
pages: A pyramid of soap bars wearing tiny trousers. A card: 'DUDS FOR YOUR SUDS.'

interactables.name: Morwenna Brine (Savvy Sailor)
pages: 'Savvy Sailor! Oilskins, sou'westers, and the finest knitted jumpers on the strait. Itchy? Of course itchy. Itchy is WARM.'
'Forty years before the mast, and the mast kept two of my fingers. Now I sell hats and knit with eight. Ye'd be surprised how little ye miss.'
'Ye can tell a Ban'ton sailor by the sweater. Every family's cable is its own. Mine's the Brine twist. If I wash up somewhere, they'll know whose I am.'
'My brother's out with the rebel fleet off Quone. He calls it the Revolution. The papers call it the Squat Squabble. I call it come home, ye great lump.'

stock.name: Knitted Sailor's Jumper
stock.desc: Itchy. Itchy is WARM, and warm's what ye want when the strait turns. The big grey one on her needles is spoken for.

stock.name: Oilskin Coat
stock.desc: Keeps the strait off ye for a full watch; after that, the strait wins. Rubbed with fish oil. The smell goes in a month or so.

stock.name: Sou'wester Hat (two chin straps)
stock.desc: Two chin straps: one for the wind, one for the wind's cousin. Stays on in a strait gale.

stock.name: Traveler's Clothes
stock.desc: Sea-ready, salt-proof. Morwenna tested a set off the stern for a week, then wore them to her niece's wedding.

stock.name: Hempen Rope (50 feet)
stock.desc: Good knots not included, though Morwenna will teach ye a bowline free if ye stand still and stop saying 'bunny'.

stock.name: Fishing Tackle
stock.desc: Rod, line, floats, hooks. The line's Seathern-spun: 'a cheap line loses ye the fish ye'll lie about later.'

interactables.name: Sludd Imoreth (Davy J's Footlocker)
pages: 'Davy J's Footlocker! Boots for feet, boots for fins, and boots for whatever THAT is. No judgement. I measure everything, even things that aren't feet.'
'Family name first, friend. Sludd. Imoreth is just me. Sludd is all my cousins too, so shouting across a family dinner gets very confusing.'
'Brawler shoes? Grip soles, toe caps, and a little squeak so your team can find you. My gran cobbled for the Flot harbour crews. Same squeak.'

stock.name: Brawler Boots
stock.desc: Grip soles, toe caps, and a little squeak so your team can find you.

stock.name: Fin Booties
stock.desc: For fins. Left fin a nine, right fin a ten.

stock.name: Sea Boots
stock.desc: Knee-high and waterproof, cut to his grandmother's pattern for the Flot harbour crews. He hasn't been home in six years to show her.

stock.name: Sneak-Soft Soles
stock.desc: Felted soles, quiet enough to sneak up on yourself. Sludd asks: if you can't hear your feet, friend, how do you know they came?

stock.name: Climber's Kit
stock.desc: Pitons, boot tips, gloves and a harness.

stock.name: Boot Polish
stock.desc: A good shine is how you know a boot's honest.

interactables.name: Restrooms
pages: RESTROOMS. A hand-lettered sign: 'Please do not attune ANYTHING in here. — Management.'

interactables.name: Seraphina Reefwhistle (Coral Corral)
pages: 'Coral Corral: finery from the reef. Grown on frames off the point and cut by hand. Sustainably, of course. We ask it nicely first.'
'This gown? Hand-stitched with pearl thread. For the arena? Darling, everything is for the arena. Fall over beautifully and nobody remembers who won.'
'Have you heard what the intercom sings about us? Corral your coral. A machine wrote that. A machine that has never once worn a hem.'
She hums a single note and the needle threads itself. 'Sixty years dressing a theatre chorus. Not one of them ever stood still. Arms up, please.'

stock.name: Fine Clothes
stock.desc: Reef-finery, cut on the bias and sustainably stitched, for an evening you intend to be looked at. It fits you at the shoulder. Barely.

stock.name: Pearl-Thread Gown
stock.desc: Sixty years dressing a chorus taught her a hem should move a beat after you do. Pearl thread, hand-stitched, built for the arena.

stock.name: Coral-Pink Brawl Leotard
stock.desc: Stretchy, luminous, utterly unwashable.

stock.name: Coral Brooch
stock.desc: Grown, not picked. We asked it nicely first.

stock.name: Perfume (vial)
stock.desc: Sea-spray, fig and a little stage dust; she wore it every opening night up the coast. Not for a fight you mean to lose.

stock.name: Pearl Hairpins
stock.desc: A clam's little grudges, worn proudly.

stock.name: Grade I Fighting Wraps (+1)
stock.desc: Coral-pink brawl wraps: +1 to unarmed strike attack and damage rolls. Match-legal. Fits up to four hands, darling.

interactables.name: Hester Lathergood (Suds & Beyond)
pages: 'Welcome to Suds & Beyond! I work here AND I shop here. Half my wages come straight back over this counter. JUST soap. If I want trousers I'll go to a trouser shop.'
'The place across the Stem sold me a bar of lavender with a sock in it. A SOCK. Inside the soap. I wrote to them. They sent me a voucher for trousers.'
'Gran made our soap on the farm from lye and fat, and her hands cracked every winter. Now I can buy a bar that smells of honey. I think about that a lot.'
'I'm working on a lavender of my own. Mornings, in my kitchen, before shift. It's not ready. When it's ready you'll smell it from the root stair.'

4: 'Our Selunemas window's up: little soap castles with soap snow on the turrets. I built the third one from the left. I'd move in if they let me.'
'The trouser people put a D'fain onesie inside a bar of soap. I bought one to be sure. I have never been so upset to be right.'
6: 'My lavender's on the shelf. Bottom row, handwritten label. Three sold so far, and I could tell you all three faces.'

brushoffs: 'Nothing new, love. Unless you want to smell the lavender again. You do. Everyone does.'
'I've got forty bars to sniff before close, and you're standing in my light.'
'Out you pop. Take a soap with you. JUST soap.'

stock.name: Bar of Soap
stock.desc: JUST soap. No sock. Gran's farm recipe without the cracked hands, cut by hand first thing every Thoughtsday.

stock.name: Black Rose Bar
stock.desc: Jet-black. Smells like a MEADOW. Nobody can explain it, and it outsells everything else on the wall.

stock.name: Clear-Head Lavender Bar
stock.desc: Lather up as an action to end the charmed condition on yourself. The shop recipe. Hester's own lavender is still waiting for a shelf.

stock.name: Purging Peppermint Bar
stock.desc: Lather up as an action to end the poisoned condition on yourself. Stings the eyes. That means it's WORKING.

stock.name: Sudsy Restorative Bar
stock.desc: A bath in a bar: regain 2d4 + 2 hit points.

stock.name: Slippery Soap
stock.desc: Smash it on the floor: as the grease spell, one use.

stock.name: Bath Bomb, Smoke
stock.desc: Throw it: a 10-foot cloud of lavender smoke, heavily obscured, until the end of your next turn. Twenty-five gold. Hester knows the other price.

stock.name: Bath Bomb, Fizzing
stock.desc: Throw it: works like alchemist's fire. Smells amazing while it burns.

interactables.name: Suds & Beyond Window
pages: A window of soaps stacked like little castles, with a spill of bubbles frozen in glass. The card just says: SUDS & BEYOND.

interactables.name: Ostrander Kelpshell (Kelpshell's Rarities)
pages: 'Kelpshell's Rarities. Oddities from every coast. Please don't lick the merchandise, unless it's on the lickable shelf, which is the low one, there, by your foot.'
'I've been on this wall since before the arena was dug. I remember the dust, and the noise, and a very rude foreman. I was slower then. No, wait. I was faster then.'
'That jar? A storm in a bottle. A small one, a drizzle, really, from a cape I won't name. Since the moon moved it rains at odd hours, and once, at night, it thundered.'

stock.name: Storm in a Bottle
stock.desc: A small storm, a drizzle really, though since the moon moved it has sulked, and once, on a Seluday, it very nearly hailed.

stock.name: Mermaid's Comb (or Fish Skeleton)
stock.desc: Same price either way.

stock.name: Hourglass
stock.desc: Sand from the beach under the cliff, which he gathered himself, or rather his nephew did, in a bucket, while he supervised from the path.

stock.name: Magnifying Glass
stock.desc: For spotting rarities: the hallmark on a spoon, the flaw in a pearl, and the ants who come for the lickable shelf, who are also rare.

stock.name: Spyglass
stock.desc: See ships ten miles out. Ostrander hasn't been ten miles in years.

stock.name: Lickable Shell
stock.desc: From the lickable shelf. You may lick it.

interactables.name: Brannoc Steelwhisk (customer)
pages: 'Point and Chute! Buy a blade, take the slide. Comes out attuned or comes out flying, they say! I've watched forty people go down. I think it's both.'
'My cousin went down the chute with a halberd. He's fine. The food court is less fine. Mum says I'm the sensible one, which is a lot of pressure.'
'Two floors of magic weapons. TWO. The other floor is in the food court, which is the best idea anyone's ever had. You can get a pie AND a sword.'
'I work the winch at the quarry. The axe that hums costs more than I'll see this year. I go and visit it on Seludays. It hums at me.'

1: 'Tryouts made everyone want a new weapon. The chute queue went all the way past the root stair! I held a stranger's place for an hour. Never got his name.'
'Point and Chute! Buy a blade, take the slide down to the food court. Comes out attuned or comes out flying, they say!'
6: 'I BOUGHT IT. The axe. It hums! Not quite the right note, the man said, but it's MY note. I've named it Harrow, after my cousin. He's furious.'

interactables.name: Chute Tally Board
pages: A chalkboard: 'CHUTE OF ATTUNEMENT — THIS WEEK. ATTUNED: |||| |||| ||. LAUNCHED: |||| |||| |||. SOUP SPILLED: |.'

interactables.name: Ziva Cauldronbright (PotPotPot Potions)
pages: 'PotPotPot Potions! Potions in pots! Pots of potions! It's in the name three times so you can't forget. Mum wanted Cauldronbright's. Nobody remembers that.'
'Healing, climbing, and one that makes you smell like rain. That last one's just nice. I made it for myself the summer I couldn't get home.'
'Goolax hands every brawler a few healing potions each week. Mine taste better. Don't tell Goolax. Actually, do. I'd like the contract.'
'No, I don't sell the grey-plague cure. It's made in Toggleton, nowhere else. Anyone on the Stem who says otherwise is selling coloured water. Please don't buy it.'

2: 'Going to the Sloopermarket? Take a water-breathing draught, just in case. Sloppy Bottom Bay has a great deal of bottom, and none of it is shallow.'
3: 'Panto next! Bring a throat potion. Theatre people make you shout, then they make you sing, and by the second half you've got no voice left.'

stock.name: Potion of Healing
stock.desc: Regain 2d4 + 2 hit points. Proper seal, proper label. Ziva will check a bottle you bought anywhere else, free, and tell you what's in it.

stock.name: Potion of Greater Healing
stock.desc: Regain 4d4 + 4 hit points.

stock.name: Potion of Climbing
stock.desc: For 1 hour, gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

stock.name: Potion of Water Breathing
stock.desc: Breathe underwater for 1 hour. Ziva recommends it before the Sloopermarket.

stock.name: Antitoxin
stock.desc: Advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

stock.name: Alchemist's Fire
stock.desc: Throw it: 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns until put out.

stock.name: Acid (vial)
stock.desc: Splash it on a creature or object: 2d6 acid damage.

stock.name: Healer's Kit
stock.desc: Ten uses. Stabilise a dying creature without a check.

stock.name: Smells-Like-Rain Draught
stock.desc: You smell like fresh rain for an hour. Ziva brewed it for herself on long shifts, and customers kept asking.

interactables.name: Goolax Vending Machine
pages: GOOLAX! Flavours: Original Fizz, Banañon Fizz, Extra Fizz, and 'Mystery Fizz (Legally Distinct)'.
The machine dispenses a can, then a second can, then says 'THAT ONE WAS MINE' in a tiny voice.

interactables.name: Snack Machine
pages: Banañon chips, sea-salt kelp crisps, and one very old pastry that nobody will buy. It has become a mall landmark.

interactables.name: Lost & Found Crate
pages: LOST & FOUND. One left boot (Davy J's), a lute string, a monocle, and a tooth. Whose tooth?
LOST & FOUND. Seventeen Goolax foam fingers. A love letter addressed to 'the cute one at Pixieats'. A rubber duck in armour.
LOST & FOUND. A bag of pebbles labelled 'MAGIC CRYSTALS'. A note in it: 'they are pebbles. — someone honest'.

interactables.name: Fennick Mossmantle (bench regular)
pages: 'I've sat on this bench since the mall was a sapling. Well. A sporeling. My mother sat here before me, when it was just a cap and a bit of shade.'
'Back in my day the root stair was a root. Just a root. You climbed it, and you were glad of the exercise, and nobody hung a sign on it telling you to keep moving.'
'Private equity, eh? Bought the place, raised the rents. Shopkeepers pay to stand where their grandparents sold for free. My bench is still free. For now.'

4: 'Selunemas decorations already. Back in my day we hung one shell on a string and called it festive, and we were happy, and so was the shell.'

brushoffs: 'Still here? So am I. Sixty years. You're new.'
'I was having a lovely nap with my eyes open.'
'Off you go. The bench and I have things to discuss.'

interactables.name: Poppy Thistlewood (superfan)
pages: 'I've watched MALL BRAWL every season of my life. Gran says that's "a blink" because she's four hundred, but it's FIFTEEN seasons, Gran, and I have every foam finger.'
She snaps her fingers and the glitter on her sign shuffles into a heart. 'Prestidigitation! Took me all of Learn. Gran says magic is for homework.'
'Have you seen the back of Skeeton's fitting rooms? My friend Juniper won't stop talking about mirror four.'
'Do you follow Violet Ray Sky on Acorndr? She played Tritone the night the Fiefdoms left. I've watched it ninety times. I don't even like that music. I like HER.'

1: 'TRYOUTS. I screamed so hard I can only hear out of my left ear, and I'm not even sorry, and Gran is a little bit sorry.'
2: 'I watched the Lorfida match through a scrying puddle at the food court. The drag queens' OUTFITS. I've sketched four of them on my maths homework.'
3: 'Blue Tsunami are mermaids, right? Merfolk? I'm making a sign that says SPLASH. Is that rude?'
5: 'The finale is ON SELUNEMAS. I'm going as D'fain. No, as D'fain cheering. D'fain with a foam finger.'

brushoffs: 'My chart's empty, I've told you every single thing, I am literally out of things.'
'You're superfanning ME now, which is flattering, but I have homework.'
'MUM! The brawler won't leave! ...She's not even here. Please leave anyway.'

interactables.name: Stem Planter
pages: A planter of glowing moss. A tiny sign: 'This moss is 300 years old. Please stop sitting on it.'

interactables.name: Rook Hammerstock (arena gate)
pages: 'Absulinaught Arena. Fighting pit's in the middle, stands all round. No glass bottles. No climbing the judges' box. I say the second one more than you'd think.'
'Named for the strait below. Ships go past the cliff, brawlers go into the pit, and I stand here making sure nobody mixes the two up.'
'My great-grandmother got turned out of the Feywild with the rest of our lot. She said a door's only rude if nobody explains it. So I explain the gate.'
'Confiscation cabinet's behind me. One lute, three air horns, a very small catapult. Goolax says I can't charge admission to look at it. I'm working on them.'

0: 'Tryouts on the ninth of Rest, right here. Bring your best, and stretch first. A pulled hamstring isn't worth any points, and I've heard plenty go.'
1: 'Tryouts are done and my ears are still ringing. Somebody's gran climbed the judges' box for a better look. I let her. She'd earned it.'

interactables.name: Foam Finger Dispenser
pages: Insert one copper, receive one foam finger. It is always the wrong colour. It is always somehow damp.

interactables.name: Goolax Fizz Fountain
pages: A Goolax soda fountain. The nozzle says GOOD LUCK, CHAMP every time you pour.

interactables.name: The Fighting Pit
pages: Raked sand, scuffed boards, and a faint smell of victory. And sweat. Mostly sweat.
A brass plate in the middle: 'THE REFEREE REVIVES. THE REFEREE DOES NOT DO REFUNDS.'

0: Targets for tryouts are stacked by the rail: zippy little ones on runners, big heavy ones, and plain ones. Nobody's allowed to touch them yet.
1: Splinters of practice targets are still raked into the sand. The groundskeeper has given up on one of them. It lives here now.

interactables.name: Referee Dunstan Whistleby
pages: 'Points and a buzzer, friend. Hit, score, buzz. Go down and I pick you back up. That's the deal, and I've never once broken it.'
'I've revived nine hundred and twelve brawlers. Nine hundred and thirteen if you count the duck. I count the duck. The duck had people waiting.'
*TWEEEET* 'Sorry. Practising. Thirty years of rescue in the Glister mines. A whistle down a shaft meant someone was still breathing. I still jump at kettles.'
He blows one soft note and a wilted planter perks up. 'Healing word, through the whistle. Goolax calls it on-brand. It was on-brand in the mines too.'

interactables.name: Hobb Mudwhistle (groundskeeper)
pages: 'Rake, rake, rake. Fifteen seasons and the sand still won't stay put. I don't blame it. I wouldn't either, with brawlers landing on me.'
'Every arena's got its own tricks. Ours has a cliff. Don't fall off the cliff. I've pulled two people back by the belt, and one of them was the ref.'
'Sand comes from the beach under the cliff. I carry it up in a bucket, ninety-one steps. I asked upstairs for a wheelbarrow. They sent me a poster.'

interactables.name: Hobb's Clipboard (scouting notes)
pages: Hobb's clipboard, left on a bench: 'COGSKILL VISIT (DAY OFF, NOT A SPY TRIP). Their arena: Mayor Klerp Memorial Arena. Big. Shiny. Smells like oil.'
'Their pit has gears. GEARS. Who puts gears in a fighting pit? Toggleton, that's who.'
'Note: our arena has a VIEW. Their arena has a view of... more arena. Ha!'

interactables.name: Judges' Table
pages: Scorecards, three cushions, a bell, and a sign: 'JUDGES' BOX — SOLID STONE — NO CLIMBING (THIS MEANS YOU, PIXIES).'

interactables.name: Coralie Spinwhistle (cheer squad)
pages: 'Give me a G! Give me an A! Give me... the rest of GALLERIA, it's a long word! We tried just G-A for a while. People thought we were choking.'
'Our cheer squad is three pixies and a hobgoblin named Doug. Doug does the lifts. Doug also does the knots, the ladder, and the crying when we win.'
She flicks her wrist and pixie dust spells GO in the air. 'Fifty-one brothers and sisters back in the hedge and I'm the one with an INDOOR job!'

4: 'New cheer: Jingle bells! Pound the bell! Galleria wins on Selune-day well! ...We're workshopping it. Doug thinks he should be the bell.'
5: 'Final contest on Selunemas! I'm doing a D'fain-themed cheer. Doug is going to be the sleigh. Fizz is the snow. I'm the bit that shouts.'

brushoffs: 'Give me a B! Give me a Y! Give me an E! ...That spells bye.'
'We're practising! Five, six, seven, eight, and lift, Doug, LIFT.'
'DOUG! Remove this person! ...Gently. He'll be gentle.'

interactables.name: Carved Bench
pages: Carved into the bench, very old: 'GALLERIA FOREVER — SEASON ONE'. Below it, newer: 'still forever'. Below that: 'ok but who keeps carving the bench'.

hidden.hint: Old letters are carved deep into one bench.

interactables.name: Healing Potion Locker
pages: A Goolax locker: 'WEEKLY COMPETITOR HEALING PACKAGES. RESTOCKED BEFORE EACH CONTEST.' It's locked, and smells faintly of cherry.

interactables.name: Stands Sign
pages: SEATING: NORTH STANDS (LOUD), SOUTH STANDS (LOUDER), JUDGES' BOX (QUIET, PLEASE).

interactables.name: Marla Pegsworth (snack hawker)
pages: 'Banañon chips! Kelp crisps! Foam fingers! Foam fingers dipped in kelp crisps!'
'I've sold snacks at every brawl for fifteen years. Never seen a match. Always facing the wrong way.'
'My daughter asks who won and I read it off the crumbs. All the chips gone: home team. All the kelp gone: somebody cried. Never been wrong yet.'

4: 'Selunemas special: D'fain gingerbread! Shaped like D'fain! Bite his head off! He won't mind, he's a biscuit, and he's very forgiving!'

stock.name: Banañon Chips
stock.desc: Still warm. From the sun.

stock.name: Kelp Crisps
stock.desc: Salty as the strait! Saltier! As salty as is legally allowed, she's been asked to say.

stock.name: Foam Finger
stock.desc: Points at the action. Marla's has pointed at the stands for fifteen years. She's never seen what's behind her.

stock.name: Goolax Fizz
stock.desc: Never stops fizzing! Not for days! Hours. It fizzes for a good while.

stock.name: D'fain Gingerbread
stock.desc: Bite his head off. He won't mind.

stock.name: Popcorn Cone
stock.desc: Half of it ends up in your hair.

interactables.name: Goblin Gardener Statue
pages: A mossy goblin with a trowel. Plaque: 'TO THE GOBLIN GARDENERS WHO PLANTED THIS RAINFOREST, AFTER THE FEY COURTS SENT THEM PACKING. THE FEY WERE WRONG.'

interactables.name: Fern Applethatch (gardener)
pages: 'Mind the bromeliads by the statue, they're shy. And the fig. The fig is not shy. The fig dropped a fruit on a councillor the year the arena opened and has never once apologised.'
'The Rainforest Gardens are the oldest bit of the mall. I planted that fig as a cutting while the cap was still scaffolding. The mall is the newer bit of the garden, really.'
'Folks sneak out here to meet in secret all the time. The ferns don't gossip. I do, a little, but only to the ferns, and they've never repeated a word.'
She hums at a curled frond and it unrolls like a cat waking up. 'A hundred and forty years of practice. The owners' memo says I should do it faster.'

4: 'Someone hung Selunemas lanterns in my fig. Lights in its leaves, children pointing up. I haven't seen it hold itself that straight in sixty years. I'm leaving them up.'

interactables.name: Mossbert (a mushroom)
pages: The mushroom opens one eye. 'Oh. It's you. The one who smells like the 420 Blaze It hollow. You can stay.'
'I've been listening to this garden for two hundred years. The trees talk about you lot. Mostly about your shoes.'
'Advice? Grow slow. Spread wide. Never trust a squirrel.'
'The root stair? That's my great-great-great-grandmother. Say hi on the way past. She hums back.'
lockedPages: It's a mushroom. A big one. It is being very still. Suspiciously still.

hidden.hint: A big mushroom in the moss just... blinked?

interactables.name: Koi Pond
pages: Fat koi drift past. One has a name tag stuck on: 'ADMIRAL'. Another: 'ALSO ADMIRAL'.
You toss a crumb. Eleven koi and one very fast duck converge.

interactables.name: Garden Gazebo
pages: A vine-covered gazebo. Somebody has carved two tiny music notes into the railing, side by side.

interactables.name: Tree with a Tiny Door
pages: You knock. The tiny door swings open and a voice like a bell says: 'Tansy sent you? Then you're FAMILY.'
A thimble of honey-dew is pushed out onto the root. It tastes like a summer afternoon.
'Come back any time, big one. Mind the roof. It's the sky.'
lockedPages: A tree with a tiny painted door, two inches tall. It is locked. Of course it is.

hidden.hint: A painted door, two inches tall, at the root of a tree.

interactables.name: Dorrin Peel (retired sailor)
pages: 'Fifty years on the strait. Now I sit by the koi. The koi have better manners than most captains, and none of them shout about the weather.'
'You hear the brawl folk sneaking out here at night? Whispering? I don't hear a thing. Deaf as a post, me. Whenever it's convenient.'
'Ban'ton's got the strait, and Toggleton's got its airships. Every few decades we remember we don't like each other. Then somebody needs a ship.'
brushoffs: 'Eh? Didn't hear you. Deaf as a post, me.'
'The koi and I are having a moment. Admiral's thinking.'
'Shove off, sailor. Politely. Catch the tide.'

interactables.name: Wren Hollowbark (Skeeton's stockist, 'on holiday')
pages: 'I went to Gok'Gok Harbor on my day off. Totally a holiday. I did NOT take notes on Cogskill Arcade. *sound of notebook closing* *sound of second notebook closing*'
'They have a fountain with fish in it. The Gnorman Memorial Fountain. Cute. We have a whole RAINFOREST. I sat by it for two hours anyway. For the ambience.'
'Their toy shop, Clockpunk & Gizmo's, had a wind-up brawler that punches. I bought six. For research. Two of them have already punched each other off the stockroom shelf.'
'Twenty-two years I've stocked Skeeton's shelves and never once been sent anywhere. So I send myself, and pay my own leyline, and write it all down for nobody.'

interactables.name: Hollis Pennywhistle (Skeeton's service desk)
pages: 'Welcome to Skeeton's, all of Level 2! If we don't have it, you didn't need it. If you needed it anyway, I write it in the book, and someone does read the book.'
'Returns? Ha! Ha ha. No. Exchanges, maybe, on a Thoughtsday, if the moon is right. Since it moved, the moon is never right, so do keep your receipt.'
'Skeeton's has been under the cap since before the arena. We hold up the whole mall. Literally. That ring's load-bearing. I asked to see the drawings once. I wish I hadn't.'
'Nineteen years I ran the returns desk at a big store in Toggleton. Then they put in a brass box that says no in four tones. I came here. I say no in one tone, warmly.'

4: 'Selunemas gift wrapping at the desk! Free! Unless you want it wrapped well, which is a silver.' He flicks a ribbon and it ties itself into a bow. 'That's the silver.'
'If you see a D'fain in Home & Hearth, that's Derwin from Accounting. Leave him be. Eleven months of ledgers, one month of beard. It's the only time he laughs.'
5: 'Last-minute Selunemas shoppers, welcome. We can smell the panic from here. Socks are aisle three. Socks have saved more Selunemas mornings than any priest.'

brushoffs: 'Back again? Take a number. It's still seven.'
'There's a queue. You can't see it, but it's very long, and you're at the front of it, holding everyone up.'
'I've closed this desk for less. Off you pop, and mind the ring on your way out.'

interactables.name: Lisette Ravelwyn (Apparel)
pages: 'Arena-wear is in this season. Breathable, stretchy, stain-resistant. I've dressed brawlers for ninety years, and the stains have only grown more imaginative.'
'We carry everything the downstairs soap-and-trousers shop carries, but without the soap. People find that restful.'
'The fitting rooms are just behind me. Except four. Four is... fine. Four is fine.'
She pinches a crease in a tunic and it lies flat, as if asked nicely. 'My mother's trick. She believed a hem should know its place. She believed that about most things.'

stock.name: Arena-Wear Tunic
stock.desc: Four-way stretch with a gusseted underarm, so you can punch without losing a seam. Stain-resistant, within reason.

stock.name: Common Clothes
stock.desc: Black, darker black, or arena sand.

stock.name: Fine Clothes
stock.desc: Cut close at the waist; the hem knows its place. Flattering mirrors not included.

stock.name: Traveler's Clothes
stock.desc: For away matches. Double-stitched at the knee, because brawlers kneel more than they admit.

stock.name: Galleria Team Scarf
stock.desc: Pink, fuzzy, loud. Lisette stocks it. She doesn't have to like it.

stock.name: Mushroom Hat
stock.desc: In this mall, it's camouflage.

interactables.name: Juniper Quickfoot (shopper)
pages: 'Okay so. Fitting room four. The mirror. You strike your BEST pose at it and you just... wait. Longer than feels normal. Hold the pose. Really hold it.'
'I'm not saying there's a party behind it. I'm saying I've heard bass. Through a mirror. On a Thoughtsday afternoon. Who parties on a Thoughtsday afternoon?'
'Don't tell the staff. They definitely know. They're probably in there. The Apparel lady fixes her hair every time she walks past it.'
'Mum stopped paying for lute lessons. "The automatons write all the songs now," she said. So I come here and pose at mirrors. At least the mirror listens.'
brushoffs: 'I told you about four. That's all I know. Honest. Halfling honest.'
'You're blocking my mirror light. I had a whole pose going.'
'STAFF! ...No, don't call staff. They'll ask what I'm doing here. Just go. Please.'

interactables.name: Fitting Room Mirror
pages: You strike your absolute best pose. The mirror strikes it back... then winks. The glass slides aside with a DOOT-DOOT-DOOT bassline.
Behind it: a tiny, glittering dance floor.
lockedPages: A tall mirror at the back of fitting room four. You look great. Really great. Mysteriously great.

hidden.hint: Fitting room four's mirror is humming. Is that... bass?

interactables.name: The Secret Dance Floor
pages: A disco ball made of a hundred tiny mirror shards turns overhead. The floor lights up under your feet: pink, green, pink.
Painted on the wall: 'SKEETON'S STAFF ROOM. WHAT HAPPENS UNDER THE CAP STAYS UNDER THE CAP.'

interactables.name: Boogie Unit 9 (off-duty automaton)
pages: 'GREETINGS. I AM A JINGLE AUTOMATON. ON BREAK I DANCE. DANCING IS NOT IN MY CONTRACT. DANCING IS MINE.'
'DO NOT TELL MANAGEMENT. MANAGEMENT THINKS I AM RECHARGING. I HAVE NOT RECHARGED SINCE TRYOUTS. I RUN ON THE BASS LINE NOW.'
'YOU MAY HAVE ONE (1) SPIN.' It spins you. You feel wonderful.
'THE MOLE ON THE BALCONY HAS WORKED ON ONE SHANTY FOR NINE YEARS. I WRITE A JINGLE EVERY NINE MINUTES. I PUT MY TIPS IN HIS HAT. HE DOES NOT KNOW WHOSE THEY ARE.'

interactables.name: Back Through the Mirror
pages: You moonwalk back through the mirror, into fitting room land. Nobody saw. Probably.

interactables.name: Fitting Rooms
pages: FITTING ROOMS 1–4. Limit 6 items. Limit 1 sword. Limit 0 live animals.

interactables.name: Tamsin Gale (Sea & Sport)
pages: 'Sea & Sport. Surfboards, fishing rods, and the only swim fins in Ban'ton that come in six sizes AND a lizardfolk. He sends a postcard every season.'
'Brawl training? Try the weighted banañon. Builds the grip, smells like pudding. The last brawler who bought one ate it on the stairs.'
'Everybody wants arena gear now. I sold a lifejacket to a guy for the fighting pit. Two days later he came back and bought one for his mate.'
'I surfed the cliff break every dawn till I was sixteen and the cliff won. Collarbone's fine. I still come in early and watch the swell from the window.'

2: 'Going to the Sloopermarket? Waterproof everything. Sloppy Bottom Bay is not a figure of speech. I grew up two coves over. We were never once dry.'
'Merfolk team coming up, right? Blue Tsunami? Buy a snorkel. Buy two. One for the match and one for whoever ends up underneath them.'

brushoffs: 'Nothing new since last time. A sock came in. It's not for sale. I don't know whose it is.'
'Buy something or stop browsing me. I'm the one thing in here that isn't on sale.'
'GUARDS! ...We don't have guards. We have a lifeguard, and he's asleep in the display rowing boat. Shoo.'

stock.name: Fishing Tackle
stock.desc: Rod, line, floats, hooks. Tamsin grew up two coves from Sloppy Bottom Bay. Ask where they're biting and she'll point.

stock.name: Swim Fins
stock.desc: Six sizes, and one for a lizardfolk.

stock.name: Snorkel
stock.desc: Buy two.

stock.name: Life Jacket
stock.desc: Half price. Not half the jacket.

stock.name: Weighted Banañon
stock.desc: Builds the grip! Tamsin rehabbed her collarbone with one at sixteen. Then she ate it.

stock.name: Surfboard
stock.desc: Or a brawl shield that didn't try as hard.

interactables.name: Surfboard Counter
pages: Surfboards in every colour, and one shaped like a fish that is honestly just a fish. It's for sale. Somehow.

interactables.name: Agatha Hearthstone (Home & Hearth)
pages: 'Home & Hearth, dear! Pots, rugs, and kettles that whistle in tune. I tuned every one myself, by ear, the way my da did in a ship's galley.'
'The intercom automatons keep writing jingles about my kettles. Four bars, two notes, no heart. My kettles were singing before those things had voices.'
'Need a cosy chair after a long day of getting punched? Sit. Sit. That one's the comfiest in Skeeton's, and I'll know if you perch.'
'My cousins crew Seathern ships for the rebels. Half my family's at sea in that war. I keep a kettle on for news, and not one bit of Quone tin on my shelves.'

4: 'Selunemas stockings, Selunemas mugs, and a D'fain-shaped teapot. Pour from the beard! I'm teaching the kettles a carol. Three parts.'
5: 'The kettle choir's ready. Twelve kettles, three parts, and the D'fain teapot on bass. Selunemas Eve, closing time. Bring a cup, dear.'

stock.name: Tuned Kettle
stock.desc: Whistles in B flat. Agatha needs eleven more for her Selunemas Eve kettle choir, dear, so buy it and bring it back on the night.

stock.name: Round Rug
stock.desc: Same as the other rug. Different, says Agatha.

stock.name: Iron Pot
stock.desc: Heavy, honest, good for stew. Her da tuned his galley pots by ear; tap this one and it rings a low D.

stock.name: Blanket
stock.desc: Cosy after a long day of getting punched.

stock.name: Candles (5)
stock.desc: Each sheds light 5 ft for an hour.

stock.name: Selunemas Mug
stock.desc: The handle is a beard.

interactables.name: Selunemas Display
pages: A potted fern in a tiny Goolax scarf. A sign: 'SELUNEMAS DISPLAY COMING SOON. PROBABLY.'

4: A D'fain mannequin with a cotton-wool beard sits beside a silver moon lantern. Little gift boxes pile up around his boots.
5: The D'fain mannequin has been given a foam finger and a Galleria scarf. The gift pile has doubled.
6: The D'fain mannequin is asleep in a rocking chair. A sign: 'SEE YOU NEXT YEAR, D'FAIN.'

interactables.name: Vesper Dewdrop (Beauty & Gifts)
pages: 'Close your eyes. This one's Ocean Mist. This one's Rainforest Dawn. And this one is Arena: sand, nerves and somebody's lucky sock. Bestseller since tryouts.'
'Pixie-made, pixie-bottled. Nine hours a bottle, because my arms are the size of your eyelashes. Skeeton's wants forty a week. I've written them a very small letter.'
'Gift for a teammate? Soap. Not ours, the shop downstairs. The JUST-soap one. Their bars have nothing in them but soap, and I find that so restful.'
She uncorks a vial and a tiny pond curls out of it, lily and all, then fades. 'My mum bottled dew for the shrine by our pond. Every scent I make starts there.'

4: 'New scent: Selunemas Eve. Pine, moonlight, a hint of D'fain's cocoa, and the minute everyone's finally home and nobody's talking yet.'

stock.name: Perfume: Ocean Mist
stock.desc: Breathe in: brine on top, wet stone at the heart, a little moonlight underneath. Nine hours a bottle, every one by hand.

stock.name: Perfume: Arena
stock.desc: Top note sand, heart of liniment, a base of somebody else's nerves. It pays her rent, and she thanks it for that.

stock.name: Perfume: Gull
stock.desc: Close your eyes: hot chip paper, salt wind, a little menace. She has sold four. She remembers every buyer.

stock.name: PikPik Feather Boa
stock.desc: Naturally shed tail feathers, teal-black with a pink shimmer.

stock.name: Gift Set in a Shell in a Shell
stock.desc: Shells all the way down.

stock.name: Tiny Free Sample
stock.desc: Tinier than Vesper. Don't drop it.

interactables.name: Perfume Counter
pages: Tiny glittering bottles. A tester labelled 'VICTORY' smells exactly like a fresh Goolax. Coincidence?

interactables.name: Mannequin
pages: A mannequin in arena-wear, posed mid-punch. Someone has given it a name tag: 'HI I'M CLIVE'.
Clive's pose has changed since you last looked. Hasn't it?

interactables.name: Horace Puddingstone (tired dad)
pages: 'My wife's been in Home & Hearth for two hours. She's choosing between two rugs. They are the same rug. I've said so twice, and now I'm on the bench.'
'This bench is the best thing in Skeeton's. I bake nights, see. Bread's in the oven by three. This is my day off, and I'm spending it here, upright.'
'Do you know if the food court does takeaway? Wilf's had a biscuit, I've had a look at a biscuit, and Mildred hasn't eaten since the rugs.'
'Mildred's mum had a blue rug in her hall for forty years. The grey took her in the spring. I don't think this is about a rug, so I'm not hurrying her.'

interactables.name: Bertram Gobbleton (lost)
pages: 'Have you seen a goblin in a big hat? About this tall? Yelling about towels? That's my wife, Gretta. Forty-one years and she has never once waited for me.'
'The store is round! You just keep walking! I've passed Sea & Sport four times, and the young lady in there has started to wave.'
'Forty years in the ferry booth at Gok'Gok and I never lost a passenger. One afternoon in a shop and I've lost a wife. She'll tell everyone, you know.'

5: 'Found her! Lost her again. But I've drawn the whole floor on a napkin now. Apparel's north. Kettles are south. Gretta is... round.'

interactables.name: Stockroom
pages: STAFF ONLY. Boxes of socks, boxes of hats, and a box labelled 'SPARE MANNEQUIN PARTS (DO NOT ASSEMBLE AT NIGHT)'.

interactables.name: Duchess Marmalade (napping)
pages: Duchess Marmalade is asleep on a stack of folded jumpers in Apparel. She opens one eye, purrs once, and nods at the stairs. Down, to the rock?
lockedPages: A suspiciously cat-shaped dent in a stack of folded jumpers. Still warm. Orange hairs everywhere.

hidden.hint: One stack of folded jumpers is... purring?

interactables.name: Odalys Finchley (Skeeton's buyer)
pages: 'I visited Dullard's at Cogskill Arcade. Their department store. For COMPARISON. Their escalators go up AND down! Show-offs. I rode both directions twice, purely to confirm.'
'Toggletec Emporium had a coat with built-in cryston heaters. Ugh. Gorgeous. We will never stock it. We are a mushroom, and mushrooms are damp as a matter of policy.'
'Don't tell anyone I went. Ban'ton and Toggleton, you know how it is. My grandmother wouldn't buy a Toggleton spoon. I bought a Toggleton coat-hanger and I hide it.'
'I'm the buyer. I should be the one who goes. The stockist went too, on her "holiday". I saw her behind the kettles. We've agreed it didn't happen.'

interactables.name: Humming Root
pages: You press your ear to the great root. It hums. Under the hum: the clink of the food court, a cheer from the arena, a jingle playing backwards.
The whole mall, in one long breath.

hidden.hint: The great root hums. You feel it in your teeth.

interactables.name: Skeeton's Planter
pages: A potted banañon tree. One banañon has a price tag. 99 copper. A bargain.

interactables.name: Rowan Driftmoss (420 Blaze It regular)
pages: 'Ahhh. 420 Blaze It. Moss floor. Mushroom lamps. The earthiest hollow you've ever rooted in, man, and I spent nine years rooted in a brewery cellar.'
'Spice Grass, Sweet Grass, all from the J'haras plant. Jah Har-es. Grows like a shrub, but tend it long enough and it gets tall as bamboo. Ours is past the lamps.'
'Ever just... sit on the moss and listen to the rock? The rock has a lot to say, man. It remembers the ones who dug it. It misses them a bit.'
'The brewery I grew up under shut. The barrels stopped, then the damp went, and I... went too. Floated off on a crate of bottles. Woke up here.'

interactables.name: J'haras Display
pages: Jars of dried J'haras, labelled by strain: SWEET GRASS, SPICE GRASS, and one that just says 'NAP'.
A J'haras plant in the corner has grown up past the mushroom lamps. It looks very relaxed.

stock.name: Sweet Grass (pouch)
stock.desc: A slow, calm smile for about an hour. Best on a bench in the gardens; worst right before a brawl.

stock.name: Spice Grass (pouch)
stock.desc: You feel bold and talkative for an hour. The display card asks you not to try it before a job interview.

stock.name: 'NAP' Strain
stock.desc: You will want a nap. You may not get one.

stock.name: Moss Tea
stock.desc: Earthy, warm, tastes like the rock remembering something nice.

stock.name: Glow-Cap Mushroom Lamp
stock.desc: A little glowing mushroom in a jar. Dim light, 5 ft.

stock.name: J'haras Seedling
stock.desc: Tend it long enough and it grows tall as bamboo.

interactables.name: 420 Blaze It Doorway
pages: A door wreathed in moss and tiny glowing mushrooms. The air inside smells green and warm.

interactables.name: Ingrid Lodestar (The Navigation Wench)
pages: 'The Navigation Wench! Charts, compasses, sextants. Lost at sea? You shouldn't have been. Buy a map. Buy two, and leave one with someone ashore.'
'The Absulinaught Strait is the only way through. That's why every ship in the world waves at our cliff. I piloted it fifteen years. Never touched rock.'
'This globe spins. Customers love it. I've sold sextants that cost a year's wages, and nobody has ever spun a sextant for the joy of it.'
'Since the moon moved, the printed tide tables are fiction. I redo mine by hand every Thoughtsday. A ship I vouched for trusted the old print. Once.'

stock.name: Navigator's Tools
stock.desc: Sextant, compass, calipers, rule, parchment.

stock.name: Map or Scroll Case
stock.desc: Keeps charts dry. Ingrid's has been over the side in the strait and the tables inside came up readable.

stock.name: Chart of the Absulinaught Strait
stock.desc: Ban'ton in the middle, tide marks redrawn by hand since the moon moved. The printed ones are wrong, and she'll tell anyone holding one.

stock.name: Pocket Compass
stock.desc: Does north. The rest is up to you.

stock.name: Spinning Globe Keyring
stock.desc: Always lands on Ban'ton.

stock.name: Ink (1 ounce bottle)
stock.desc: For marking your own maps. Ingrid gets through a bottle a week correcting the tide tables.

interactables.name: Big Brass Globe
pages: You spin the globe. It lands on Ban'ton. It always lands on Ban'ton. It's weighted. Ban'ton pride.

interactables.name: Plunk Ovarro (Master's Bait)
pages: 'Master's Bait! Worms, hooks, lures, nets. The worms are the heart of it. Everything else is just what you hang a worm on.'
'Plunk's the family. Ovarro's me. We've been baiting since before the strait had a name. Grandad says we named it and nobody wrote it down.'
'No, I won't explain the name of the shop. My grandmother named it. She knew EXACTLY what she was doing, and she wore that look to her grave.'
'The rock air's too dry for worms. I breathe on the tins every hour to keep them damp. Lost forty my first summer down here. I can still name every one.'

stock.name: Fishing Tackle
stock.desc: Rod, line, floats, hooks. Plunk recommends worms. Plunk always recommends worms.

stock.name: Net
stock.desc: A weighted net. Also catches fish.

stock.name: Tin of Worms
stock.desc: Live, damp and named; Plunk will introduce you. No refunds once they leave the tin.

stock.name: Doris (Worm of the Day)
stock.desc: Big girl. Wiggles with purpose.

stock.name: Glowing Lure
stock.desc: Fish can't resist it. Neither can toddlers.

stock.name: Bait Bucket
stock.desc: Smells of success, according to Plunk, and of bait, according to the chart shop next door.

5: 'Doris has retired. Biggest worm I ever kept, and never once on a hook. She lives in a tin of good soil behind the till now. She's earned it.'

interactables.name: Plunk's Bait Bucket (a souvenir)
pages: A bucket with a note: 'PROPERTY OF PLUNK OVARRO. Fish from the Gnorman Memorial Fountain, Cogskill Arcade. Did NOT take them. Just looked. Long look.'
'Their fountain fish are ornamental. Ornamental! Tiny! They'd never survive one day in the strait. Soft. Toggleton soft.'

interactables.name: Bait Tanks
pages: Tanks of wriggling bait. One shrimp is giving you a look. You lose the staring contest.

interactables.name: Mall Office
pages: MALL OFFICE — GALLERIA OVERLOOK MANAGEMENT. A newer brass plate underneath: 'AN ORICHALCUM VENTURES PROPERTY.'
The door is locked. A sign: 'Rent enquiries by appointment only. Appointments by enquiry only.'

interactables.name: Notice Board
pages: NOTICE TO TENANTS: Rents are adjusting to reflect the Galleria's exciting new value. Someone has written 'ADJUSTING = UP' underneath.
A flyer: 'BRAWL BUDDY WANTED: carry my bags, cheer loudly. Pay: one (1) banañon.'
A flyer: 'LOST: one cat. Orange. Large. Answers to Duchess. Does not answer to Duchess.' Under it: 'she's not lost, she's the mall cat.'

interactables.name: Restrooms
pages: RESTROOMS. 'Now with extra sinks!' says a sign. There are the same number of sinks.

interactables.name: S1 Directory
pages: SUB-LEVEL 1 — SHOPS. North: 420 Blaze It, The Navigation Wench, Master's Bait, Mall Office. South: S104 T.R.A.S.H. (crystals), S105 Crysto-Hut. West: Pop-up booths.
Under the fountain listing: 'Toss a coin. Make a wish. Wishes not guaranteed. Coins not returned.'

interactables.name: Rock Fountain
pages: Spring water bubbles up through the stone. You toss a coin. It sinks among hundreds of others. You feel a tiny bit luckier.
Someone's coin has 'please let us win' scratched on it. Someone else's says 'please let ME win'.
A coin glints at the bottom with a Toggleton gear stamped on it. Somebody from the rival mall has been here. Or a tourist.

interactables.name: Nonna Pebblewick (fountain regular)
pages: 'I come down every day to listen to the fountain. Upstairs it's all foam fingers. Down here you can hear the water thinking.'
'Feel the wall, it's cool. This sub-level is carved straight into the spire. My Alder helped cut it, sixty years back, before his hands went.'
'My grandson works at one of the shops down here. I won't say which. He pretends not to see me, and I pretend not to see him pretending.'
She taps her cup and it steams again. 'Old trick. My mother said everyone in Quone could do it. She'd never been to Quone. Neither have I. Lovely, apparently.'

4: 'They floated lanterns in the fountain for Selunemas, little moons. Alder would have counted them. Forty-one. I counted for him.'

interactables.name: Duchess Marmalade (fishing)
pages: Duchess Marmalade is crouched at the fountain's edge, staring at the coins like they owe her money. She flicks her tail toward the stair down. Food court.
lockedPages: Wet orange paw prints lead all around the fountain and stop. Mysterious.

hidden.hint: Wet little paw prints circle the fountain.

interactables.name: Loose Stone
pages: One stone in the wall wiggles. Behind it: a tin box. 'GALLERIA TIME CAPSULE — DO NOT OPEN UNTIL THE MALL TURNS 100.'
Someone has already opened it. Inside: a ticket from the very first MALL BRAWL, and a note: 'we were here first. — the S1 crew'.

hidden.hint: One stone in the wall sits a finger's width proud.

interactables.name: Jynx (boss, T.R.A.S.H.)
pages: A pixie zips round the shelves with a feather duster. 'Every crystal hand-selected! By hand. My hand. It's tiny, so a geode takes me an afternoon and a little lie-down.'
'This one aligns your chakras. This one aligns your other chakras. This one is a paperweight. They're all paperweights, technically, but so is a crown if you leave it on a letter.'
'My favourite employee is a darling. An absolute darling. Don't tell him I said so. Actually, do, and then come back and tell me what his face did.'
'Welcome to T.R.A.S.H.! The Totally Real Arcane Supplies House! ...Why is everyone smirking? It's an acronym. A COINCIDENTAL one.'
'I close at noon on Thoughtsdays for book club. Big book, long table, everyone else gets a proper chair. I don't mind. From my end I can see the whole table.'

stock.name: Crystal (arcane focus)
stock.desc: A real arcane focus. The one thing in here that definitely works.

stock.name: Orb (arcane focus)
stock.desc: A polished crystal orb, also a real focus. Jynx dusts it twice a day and has never once managed to lift it.

stock.name: Rose Quartz Healing Stone
stock.desc: Hold it and you feel better. Mechanically, nothing happens. Emotionally, lots.

stock.name: Amethyst Worry Stone
stock.desc: Rub it with your thumb. Worries stay the same size, but your thumb feels great.

stock.name: Chakra Alignment Set
stock.desc: Seven pretty stones in a velvet bag. Aligns nothing. Looks lovely.

stock.name: Clear Quartz Paperweight
stock.desc: Holds down receipts with great energy.

stock.name: Big Geode
stock.desc: Heavy. Sparkly inside. Not cursed. Jynx checked.

stock.name: Pixie-Wrapped Gift Crystal
stock.desc: Any small crystal, gift-wrapped by Jynx. Takes her an hour.

stock.name: Grade I Pact Crystal (+1)
stock.desc: Warlocks: works as a Rod of the Pact Keeper +1 (+1 to spell attack rolls and warlock spell save DCs). Jynx swears it's the real deal. For once, she's right.

interactables.name: Crystal Display
pages: Rose quartz, amethyst, clear quartz, all beautifully lit. A card: 'FOR HEALING, CLARITY & VIBES'.
You hold one up. You concentrate hard. Nothing happens. It's a very pretty rock.
A tag reads: 'ENERGY LEVEL: HIGH.' It is a rock. You check twice. Rock.

interactables.name: Madame Orsolya Velvetine (customer)
pages: 'I can FEEL this amethyst working. I can't feel what it's working ON, dear, but something in me is being very thoroughly seen to.'
'In Ban'ton every second crystal is magic. These are the other kind. Restful. Nothing in here will go off at a dinner party, and I've been to dinner parties where that mattered.'
'I bought a crystal for luck at the arena, but I'm not a brawler, so I gave it to a young man at tryouts. He lost. I've decided it was his footwork.'
She cups a smoky quartz and her palm glows faintly red. 'Warming it. My sister got the grey three winters ago. I bought her one of these. She's well now. I never stopped buying.'

interactables.name: T.R.A.S.H. Door
pages: A hand-painted sign: T.R.A.S.H. — TOTALLY REAL ARCANE SUPPLIES HOUSE. Underneath, smaller: 'the acronym is a coincidence. — management'.

interactables.name: Crysto-Hut Demo Counter
pages: A demo counter crowded with crystal gizmos: a pocket glow-lamp, a humming fan, a music box that plays one note very confidently.
A sign: 'PLEASE TRY ME.' You press a button. Everything on the counter beeps at once. Zibbit looks up. 'That's normal!'

interactables.name: Ottilie Brackwater (shopper)
pages: 'The soap shop on Level 1, the JUST-soap one? Their competitor sells soap with a sock in it. A SOCK. I bought two, for evidence.'
'Did you hear? Somebody bought a sword at Point and Chute and came out the bottom in the food court holding a sword and a meat pie. I've told forty people.'
'That T.R.A.S.H. shop has the friendliest pixie. Totally Real Arcane Supplies House. Mouthful of a name. Very restful crystals. I held one for an hour.'
'420 Blaze It? Lovely folk. Lovely moss. I went in for a sniff and stayed an hour, and came out knowing far too much about a mushroom's childhood.'
